record.question: Which country has become the first country in Asia to legalise same sex marriage?
record.explanation: Answer C: Taiwan. Taiwan became the first place in Asia to enact a law allowing same-sex marriage in May 2019. Reference: https://www.loc.gov/item/global-legal-monitor/2019-06-18/taiwan-same-sex-marriage-law-enters-into-effect/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
